label: Freezer Control
info:
Controls multiple freezers via MQTT-switched power outlets. Each freezer's
internal thermostat is set to its minimum (~-25 degC), so the outlet is the
effective thermostat.

Strategy: cool only in the cheapest 15-min slots of the upcoming 24h,
subject to never letting the predicted temperature exceed t_max_c (minus a
small safety margin). No explicit low/high target — the freezer drifts
freely between planned cooling windows. PV surplus on the current slot
lowers effective price (treated as 0 for future slots).

Optimisation inputs:
  - live PV  (global.ess.pac)
  - 24h price curve (global.pp.price24, ct/kWh -> EUR/kWh)
  - learned thermal model per freezer (cooling_rate, warming_rate,
    running_power — built from 7d InfluxDB history)

Plan output:
  global.freezer_plan is a clone of global.pp.price24 with an additional
  per-slot `freezers.<name> = { state: ON|OFF, temp: <predicted degC> }`
  block, so other flows (UI, monitoring) can read when each freezer is
  scheduled to run and the expected temperature trajectory.

Reused configs (same ids as appliance and battery controller flows):
  MQTT broker     mqtt_broker_config (192.168.4.221)
  InfluxDB infra  influxdb_config_infra (temperature sensor history)
  InfluxDB tmp    influxdb_config (power sensor history)

Device wiring:
  og_gefrierschrank  temp  sensor/status/temperature/og_speis/ht/4   payload.value degC
                     pwr   tm/tele/OgSpGfr/SENSOR                     ENERGY.Power W
                     cmd   tm/cmnd/OgSpGfr/POWER                      ON|OFF
  kg_kuehltruhe      temp  sensor/status/temperature/kg_garage/ht/1   payload.value degC
                     pwr   hm/status/HM-ES-PMSw1-Pl NEQ1809653:2/POWER
                     cmd   hm/set/HM-ES-PMSw1-Pl NEQ1809653:1/STATE   true|false

User API (MQTT):
  home/freezer/<name>/override  payload: ON | OFF | AUTO (retained)
  home/freezer/<name>/status    retained JSON status snapshot

name: === Changelog ===
info:
v0.5  2026-04-24  Consume global.pp.prediction for per-slot PV and
               load forecasts (same source battery controller uses).
               Match prediction[].time ('DD.MM., HH:MM') to each
               price24 slot.t. Greedy planner now ranks slots with any
               PV surplus above slots without, breaking ties by
               effective cost - PV always wins over price, regardless
               of how cheap the grid slot is. Status plan entries now
               include pv_w per slot.
v0.4  2026-04-24  Failsafe outlet control: publish only OFF commands
               via Tasmota `event:poweroff` and HomeMatic
               `KuehltruheAus/PRESS_SHORT` (payload 1, integer). Each
               heartbeat re-extends the device-side off-timer; stopping
               the flow leaves both outlets to auto-restore to ON.
               Replace min_cycle_minutes (10) with min_on_minutes (30,
               2 price slots) and only gate ON->OFF transitions.
               Gated reason renamed from gated_min_cycle to gated_min_on.
v0.3  2026-04-23  Status payload now includes a `plan` array with
               {time, state, temp} per 15-min slot for the freezer, replacing
               the single `plan_first` field. Consumers get the full
               predicted trajectory in one retained message. Also read
               global.pp from the 'file' context store (where pricing
               persists it) so price24 and the plan are actually populated.
v0.2  2026-04-22  Replace target-band control with a forward-simulating
               price-driven planner. Plan the next 24h of 15-min slots,
               pick the cheapest slots needed to keep predicted temp under
               t_max_c - safety_margin_c. Drop t_target_low_c /
               t_target_high_c / urgency_horizon / price_hysteresis. Write
               the combined per-freezer plan to global.freezer_plan.
v0.1  2026-04-21  Initial flow: per-freezer MQTT temp+power ingest, normalized topics, state machine, 15-min-grid scheduler with PV and price forecast, thermal model learner (7-day InfluxDB query), override API, in-flow tests T1-T6.

=== In-flow decide tests ===
info:
Click any test inject button to run a scenario through fc_decide with a
fixed `now`, mocked freezer state, prices, PV and thermal model. Results
appear in the debug sidebar (filter for topic `test/...`). The decider
skips all global state and MQTT side effects when msg._test is set.
